newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end lower as Wall St weighs.
newsitem.headline: German shares end lower as Wall St weighs.

text.p: 1628 GMT - German shares end the day lower, weighed upon by a weak start on Wall Street, which revived concerns about the fate of U.S. marks and rates. General worries about EMU delay persist but cash prices generally driven by the DTB options exchange, as major options expiry looms.
* IBIS DAX index ends down 47.52 points at 3,289.59, just below DAX close of bourse trade. Faint recovery earlier was undermined by Dow Jones weak opening.
* Krupp offers 435 marks per Thyssen share, Thyssen shares reach new high of 410 marks in unofficial trade on news.
